content: MDN documents CSS print media and @page rules for pagination/layout and window.print() as the native user-invoked print flow. This keeps one semantic resume view and can use browser Save to PDF, but opens a dialog rather than promising silent download. If product requires a one-click generated PDF, use client PDF generation (pdf-lib supports browser creation and custom font embedding) and test Cyrillic font embedding, pagination, selectable text, and layout. Choose after validating expected UX.
